summary: Frontend-only verification completed for inspection reminder collapse persistence using isolated harness (no login/CRM writes). Full vitest passed 113/113 including 9 new persistence-focused tests; lint/tsc passed. Public preview loaded successfully.
action_items: No functional bug fix required from this run; keep current harness flow for regression reruns.
If desired, add a dedicated automated UI test file in repo for read-error (failRead) scenario to complement unit-level read rejection coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveTourView.tsx remains very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk and reducing testability; consider modular split when business changes are planned.
InspectionReminder persistence implementation correctly scopes preference by agent key and avoids shared fallback key usage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Harness isolation method (iframe + routed __reminder_test_bundle__.js) is still valid and stable. One transient script-side expectation mismatch occurred after reset state ordering, resolved by targeted rerun; not an app defect.
rca_of_issue: Transient failure in first long browser run: script expected collapsed testID after a reset+agent switch path where component was legitimately expanded. Follow-up targeted run confirmed 390x844 and 320x568 close-button accessibility without force and expected behavior persistence.
